coverage: Strict request fields, protocol/preparation pairing, nonfinite JSON numbers and typed malformed cursors return422 before creating jobs.
Concurrent repeated idempotency keys produce one experiment; a changed payload conflicts409. Existing idempotent reads survive missing reference setup.
Concurrent PostgreSQL claims use SKIP LOCKED; lease expiry during a row-lock wait cannot publish stale evidence.
Reclaim creates a new attempt and clears active projections while preserving old candidates, decisions, counts and artifacts.
Durable cancel before claim and during execution; independent hard deadline retains only validated partial evidence and marks insufficient execution, not a negative scientific finding.
Worker lifetime supervisor kills scientific descendants when owner pipe closes; successful child exit does not wait on the parent pipe.
Readiness requires matching successful bounded worker dependency probes, not a bare heartbeat.
Immutable raw request, target manifest, engine fingerprint, actual protocol hash, prepared-state and pose identity are checked before publication.
Artifact traversal and aliasing, content hashes and canonical relative source paths are validated; exact saved SDF corresponds to pose evidence.
Concurrent partial review changes require matching revisions; stale writes return409 with the current decision.
Incremental event sequences, filtered keyset pagination, coherent exports and attempt-scoped viewer/history remain durable.
Guarded unversioned legacy adoption upgrades only a verified known schema and preserves existing Run rows; ambiguous schemas fail without stamping or mutation.
validation.fixture_note: Concurrency, injected failures, timeout/cancellation and stale-report tests use controlled fixtures to make the failure deterministic. Actual scientific inference and artifact validation are recorded independently below.
observed_and_corrected_during_review: Readiness originally accepted an online worker without validated imports; worker health now records a bounded probe and configuration fingerprint.
Prepared reports could rewrite existing pose evidence or mismatch execution provenance; publication now validates exact request/protocol/engine and immutable pose/state content.
A process could outlive an abruptly lost worker; the lifetime-pipe supervisor now terminates its scientific process group.
Buffered stdin in the first supervisor implementation could abort normal interpreter shutdown; replaced with raw os.read and tested normal completion.
Scientific manifests included worker-owned mutable progress files; science excludes those and the worker publishes diagnostics after exit.
SQLite timestamp text comparison could repeat a pagination cursor indefinitely; normalized time comparison and a bounded traversal regression fixed it. Production PostgreSQL uses native timestamps.
Malformed cursor UUID values of int/dict/list could raise AttributeError and500; cursor shape is now strictly typed and returns422.
Review writes could overwrite another tab; PATCH with If-Match revision now detects conflicts.
Canonical source artifact paths were lost in export; additive migration c24d6e9a0f31 preserves relative_path for new rows, nullable for historical rows.

validation_scope.receptor_informed_by: The known NU6102 holo complex 1H1S was chosen as the open receptor; this is not fully prospective validation.

implementation.durability: Transactional submission, immutable resolved intent/hash, unique idempotency key, task claims with SKIP LOCKED, 45-second leases renewed every 2 seconds, attempt fencing, durable events, content-addressed hash-verified artifacts.
implementation.shutdown: Terminate scientific process group; leave unfinished lease reclaimable. User cancellation is persisted separately. Failed lease renewal stops scientific process without publishing new evidence.
implementation.legacy_compatibility: Sibling experiment tables and API; old Run tables, /runs routes and optimization worker retained. All app-managed PostgreSQL sessions now use UTC. Unversioned adoption verifies the known legacy schema, stamps only 9fa6b5f041b2, then upgrades; unknown layouts fail without modification.
implementation.list_pagination: GET /experiments?limit=50&cursor=opaque&status=state&q=substring returns items,next_cursor,has_more; cursor binds filters and immutable creation-time/UUID ordering. It is not an MVCC snapshot across requests.
implementation.scientific_execution_deadline: Frozen wall_time_limit_seconds=min(7200,max(300,evaluation_admission_seconds+120*embedding_attempts_per_candidate+180)); separate from candidate admission budget. Deadline failure preserves validated partial snapshots, records attempt.deadline_exceeded, and does not classify interruption as an objective-negative result.
implementation.publication: Only matching attempt ownership and current lease may publish. Exact raw request, engine fingerprint, target manifest and actual protocol hash are verified; prepared states and pose evidence cannot be rewritten. Scientific artifacts are hashed separately from mutable worker diagnostics.

remaining_limits: Recovery replays the bounded scientific pipeline under a new recorded attempt; it does not resume in the middle of a candidate.
One local scientific worker is the shipped configuration. No generic DAG or distributed scheduler.
Readiness includes verified bounded imports and runtime provenance; it is not a general certification of scientific accuracy.
Two immutable curated CDK2 protocols are registered. The new default grows NU6094 at C20 in1H1S; legacy1H1P history remains readable. No arbitrary target upload protocol is validated.
The v2 receptor is chosen from the known NU6102 complex. Results are receptor-informed retrospective contact hypotheses, not prospective accuracy, synthesis feasibility, affinity or potency evidence.
No garbage collector for unreferenced content-addressed blobs yet; stale attempts cannot publish them as active evidence.
Runtime/platform validation is on Apple silicon CPU; other operating systems and hardware require validation.
Artifact relative_path is nullable for historical rows created before c24d6e9a0f31.
